page.notes: Marginal line numbers 10–50 are printed at the left and are kept as notes. Right margin: small reference marks ("x", "z", "•") beside several lines are unclear and are not transcribed. The date beside the right margin near "xxxi" is read as cIↄ.Iↄ. (MD). The word "Thoma Duchrio" and the Scottish names are read from a small, uneven print and may contain errors. The line "latronem Regi" is crowded by the margin and may be misread. "M. D. xxxii" at the foot is read with some doubt. Check "Valierus", "Ioneftono" and "Boihuchiae" against the scan.
